name: proposal-team
description:
Evaluate opportunities, understand what evaluators are looking for, and develop stronger, compliant proposals.

The THINK School AI Proposal Team takes you from bid assessment through strategy, drafting, and QA.

- Chase analyzes solicitation requirements, evaluation criteria, incumbents, and opportunity intelligence.
- Priya assesses capability fit, gaps, risk, ROI, and pricing.
- Porter develops competitive positioning and win themes.
- Quinn drafts the proposal, while Diego checks requirements, evaluation-criteria coverage, consistency, compliance, and methodology.
- Maya orchestrates the workflow with human approval between each stage.
- Blair provides a separate grant-and-funder track.

Configure the team with your own company profile, pricing, case studies, and brand guidelines.

Want to build, customize, and manage AI Teams for your own workflows?

THINK School on Skool teaches you how.
